# analysis-template

analysis-template provides a template for new analysis repositories.

## Instructions

In order to create a new analysis repository the user should

1) Go to the analysis-template [GitHub repository](https://github.com/poissonconsulting/analysis-template) and choose 'Use this template'.
1) Clone the new repository.
1) Rename `analysis-template.Rmd` to the name of the new repository.
1) Confirm `run-all.R` runs without any errors.
1) Commit and push the changes to the new repository.
1) Delete the following line in `header.R`
```
project <- "analysis-template" # so runs with new working directory
```
